content: Payment webhook pitfalls: 1) pre_checkout_query must be answered within 10 seconds or transaction cancels. 2) Webhooks are at-least-once delivery - implement idempotent handling with unique payment ID + DB unique constraint. 3) Currency must match exactly (RUB in kopecks). 4) Verify webhook signatures from provider before trusting events. 5) Store payment state in DB (pending→paid→fulfilled), never drive logic from Telegram message alone.
